mainText: Hello, Verona! At 9 AM, here is today's balanced dish: we have clear skies at the Military Ridge State Trail with a temperature of 44 degrees and a moderate air quality index of 59.

The Verona Plan Commission will meet this Wednesday to review several development proposals including final plats for the Ardent Glen addition and temporary use permits. Meanwhile, the Public Works Department reminds residents they can apply for a stormwater utility credit by implementing eco-friendly practices like rain gardens.

There is plenty to do in town with trivia tonight at Hop Haus and Lake Lou-ee. Looking ahead to tomorrow, enjoy more trivia at The Bogey Factory or live music and pizza night at Wisconsin Brewing Company.
Last Thursday, October 15, the Verona Police Department conducted an arrest of a school bus driver for O W I after reports of dangerous driving behavior while transporting students.
Today's flavor of the day is the delightful Devil's Food Cake, and you can head over to Culver's when they open today at 10:00 AM.
